type: PROPOSED APP FEATURE — not implemented, not read by the app
problem: Missouri rivers (Eleven Point, Black, Current, St. Francis) continue into Arkansas; a section that starts in one state and ends in another cannot be expressed in one state's catalog.
proposal: Allow a section endpoint to reference another state's registry (e.g. {state: 'MO', point: 'Myrtle Access'}). Both registries now exist (MO v1 and this AR v1).
notDone: No cross-state sections are in either catalog; no MO points were added to the AR registry.

references.milesOrigin: not measured across the state line in this package (NLDI routing for AR started at the first AR point)
references.note: Myrtle is the last Missouri Eleven Point access (about 1 mile above the line); Dalton is the first AGFC Eleven Point ramp found in Arkansas.
sectionsThatWouldUnlock: eleven-point-river-ar: Myrtle Access → Dalton Boat Ramp

references.proposedSection: Coon Island Conservation Area (MO) → Kody Riggan Datto Boat Ramp (AR)
references.milesOrigin: not measured across the state line in this package (NLDI routing for AR started at the first AR point)
references.note: Coon Island is the southern-most Missouri Black River ramp; Kody Riggan Datto is the upper-most AGFC Black River ramp found.
sectionsThatWouldUnlock: black-river-ar: Coon Island Conservation Area → Kody Riggan Datto Boat Ramp

sectionsThatWouldUnlock: current-river-ar: T. L. Wright Memorial Access (Doniphan) → Johnston's Eddy Boat Ramp
